description: This file contains build definitions and installation instructions for various firmware packages related to AMD microcode and GPU drivers within an OpenWrt firmware build system.

methods.name: Package/amd64-microcode/install
methods.description: Defines installation steps for the AMD64 microcode package, copying firmware binaries into the target firmware directory.

methods.name: Package/amdgpu-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines installation steps for the AMDGPU firmware package, copying GPU firmware binaries into the target directory.

methods.name: Package/radeon-firmware/install
methods.description: Defines installation steps for the Radeon firmware package, copying firmware binaries into the target directory.
